title.zh: 工艺位置：Diff负责移动和重塑掺杂
title.en: Process role: Diff moves and reshapes dopants

subtitle.zh: 掺杂导入/ 浓度再分布/结深塑形/ 电性输出
subtitle.en: Dopant introduction / concentration redistribution / junction shaping / electrical output

body.zh: Diff既可能承担掺杂导入，也可能只负责把已有掺杂重新分布。
body.en: Diffusion may introduce dopants, or only redistribute dopants already present.

body.zh: 扩散后更深更宽的浓度分布
body.en: Deeper and broader concentration profile after diffusion

body.zh: 在高温下，掺杂原子从高浓度向
body.en: At high temperature, dopants diffuse from high-concentration

body.zh: 低浓度区域扩散，形成更深更宽的分布
body.en: into low-concentration regions, forming a deeper, broader profile

body.zh: 从来料到电学验证的典型步骤
body.en: Typical steps from incoming wafers to electrical verification

body.zh: 这些因素共同决定扩散结果
body.en: These factors jointly determine the diffusion result

body.zh: • 气氛流量与稳定性 • 表面状态/氧化层
body.en: • Ambient flow and stability / surface condition/oxide

body.zh: • 与前后工艺耦合 • 杂质控制
body.en: • Coupling to preceding and subsequent processes / impurity control

body.zh: 通过多维量测确认问题根因
body.en: Use multiple measurements to identify root causes

body.zh: 扩散更深可能改善部分片阻，但带来其他代价
body.en: Deeper diffusion may reduce some sheet resistances but introduces other costs

body.zh: • 有助于形成更理想的电场分布
body.en: • Helps form a more favorable electric-field distribution

body.zh: • 结深增加，占用后续热预算
body.en: • Greater junction depth consumes subsequent thermal budget

body.zh: • 可能影响相邻器件隔离
body.en: • May affect isolation of adjacent devices

body.zh: • 过度扩散导致短沟道或结击穿风险
body.en: • Excess diffusion risks short-channel behavior or junction breakdown

body.zh: 量测结果用于工艺窗口优化
• 阈值电压：由结深和通道掺杂决定
body.en: • Threshold voltage: set by junction depth and channel doping

body.zh: • 串联电阻：片阻与接触电阻相关
body.en: • Series resistance: related to sheet resistance and contact resistance

body.zh: • 击穿电压：结深与结形状影响
body.en: • Breakdown voltage: affected by junction depth and shape

body.zh: • 漏电流：结深与电场分布相关
body.en: • Leakage current: related to junction depth and electric-field distribution

body.zh: • 接触电阻：扩散形成的S/D区域
body.en: • Contact resistance: source/drain regions formed by diffusion

body.zh: • 器件隔离：横向扩散可能影响隔离效果
body.en: • Device isolation: lateral diffusion may impair isolation

body.zh: • 有源扩散：从表面引入掺杂。
body.en: • Source diffusion: introduce dopants from the surface.

body.zh: • 注入后退火：主要用于修复损伤并激活掺杂。
body.en: • Post-implant anneal: mainly repair damage and activate dopants.

body.zh: • Drive-in：在已有掺杂分布上向深处驱动扩散。
body.en: • Drive-in: move existing dopant profiles deeper.

body.zh: • 三者工艺条件和职责不同，不能简单互相替代。
body.en: • Their conditions and functions differ; they are not simply interchangeable.

Cooling and cleaning

• Remove residue
• Restore the surface
Electrical and profile verification
• Sheet-resistance/electrical testing
• SIMS/profile analysis
• Verify junction depth and profile
04
Process tradeoffs
Deeper diffusion may reduce some sheet resistances but introduces other costs
Shallow diffusion
Costs and risks
Deep diffusion
Deeper diffusion
may reduce sheet resistance
Depth
Potential benefits
• Lower sheet resistance
• Improved junction continuity
• Helps form a more favorable electric-field distribution
Costs and risks
• Increased lateral diffusion
• Greater junction depth consumes subsequent thermal budget
• May affect isolation of adjacent devices
• Excess diffusion risks short-channel behavior or junction breakdown
Measurement feedback
Typical failures
Junction too shallow
• Abnormal device conduction
• High threshold
• Electrical targets not met
Junction too deep
• Increased leakage
• Reduced breakdown voltage
• Junction occupies excessive space
Nonuniform sheet resistance / masked-region anomalies
• Dispersed sheet resistance
• Abnormal diffusion under the mask
• Inconsistent device performance
Sheet-resistance map
(Sheet-resistance uniformity)
SIMS
Junction depth
(Concentration–depth)
(Profile analysis)
Measurements optimize the process window
and close the anomaly-analysis loop
Device electrical behavior
(I–V/C–V, etc.)
Downstream effects
• Threshold voltage: set by junction depth and channel doping
• Series resistance: related to sheet resistance and contact resistance
• Breakdown voltage: affected by junction depth and shape
• Leakage current: related to junction depth and electric-field distribution
• Contact resistance: source/drain regions formed by diffusion
• Device isolation: lateral diffusion may impair isolation
Scope reminder
• Source diffusion: introduce dopants from the surface.
• Post-implant anneal: mainly repair damage and activate dopants.
• Drive-in: move existing dopant profiles deeper.
• Their conditions and functions differ; they are not simply interchangeable.
